evaluation.execution_sequence: This q005 pair is dispatched only after the ongoing q004 confirmation execution is terminal; preparation and provider-free CI may happen earlier.
evaluation.failures: Retain both scheduled profiles including missing/failed workers and unavailable answers; no replacements, solver retries, zero-filled unknowns, cherry picking or contract relaxation. No joint metric eligibility when a worker is missing.
evaluation.independent_hosts: Each worker is a fresh independent hosted job with the unchanged single-profile native body. This differs from serial same-host development pairs; no pooled cross-protocol time estimate is claimed. Pair CI makespan is operational scheduling latency, not a zg performance metric.
evaluation.input_efficiency_candidate: Both profiles source-grounded pass, zg factual score>=baseline, and complete zg model input<baseline.
evaluation.one_pair: Development observation only. A stable effect requires a separate pre-execution ten-per-profile confirmation excluding this pair; no score trimming for n=1 and repetitions are not independent tasks for task-level MAD.
evaluation.primary: Unchanged source-grounded QA quality, evaluated independently under the original ten units and mandatory C3-C5/citation gates. No quality claim from resource savings alone.
evaluation.quality_candidate: zg source-grounded pass and higher factual score or quality-success result than baseline.
evaluation.resource_scope: Complete model input=uncached+cache-read+cache-write; output separate. Preserve all original native timing scopes per profile. No billing or embedding-token inference.
shared_gates: Both scheduled original native slots complete with exact q005 source/question/task identity and complete root/child accounting.
Both strict and factual source scope and unchanged-source checks pass; false or unknown blocks a favorable valid-pair conclusion.
zg makes a successful materially relevant retrieval at the correct supplied source root.
Original independent model grading and independent consistency saved before mapping read; retain all unknown judgments.
Original worker ZIP/API/run/job/head bindings verified, two distinct hosted worker job/runner IDs proven, and all original slots and profile evidence preserved exactly during joint collection.
evaluation.static_input_retention: Retain the exact reusable static install archive once in provider-free preflight, with the pinned package SHA and original upstream derivation. Worker and joint artifacts omit only that duplicate static input; all original native slots, source/accounting/tool/session logs, worker ZIPs and metadata remain intact. Each worker still validates the full input bytes before any model call.

selection_disclosure: q005 was source-selected from the retained closed-issue pool and independently reviewed before current native q004 development answers were collected. It asks distinct runtime/API scenarios derived from closed issue395; other development outcomes are known to parent. This is a development case, not an unseen or random holdout. Earlier q001-q004 answers and any later confirmations are not pooled into this pair.
